title: Pause & Deserve
tagline: Solo horror prototype—built in 8 weeks to learn Unreal. Pause freezes the enemy, but each use makes it permanently faster.

gameplay.title: Core Concept
gameplay.desc: Solo horror prototype I made in 8 weeks to learn Unreal. The core idea: you can pause to freeze the enemy, but every time you do, it gets permanently faster. So safety now means harder later. I wanted to see if I could build and ship a complete game by myself—code, audio, everything.

soundscape.title: Forest Ambience
soundscape.desc: Basic forest sounds—rustling grass, snapping twigs, wind. Nothing fancy, just enough to make the forest feel alive.
soundscape.oppressive_desc: When you pause, a ticking clock plays. Reminds you the freeze won't last forever.
soundscape.proximity_desc: You can see the enemy, so audio isn't for tracking. But footsteps and breathing make it scarier when it gets close.
soundscape.environmental_desc: Random twigs snap around you. Leaves rustle when nothing's there. Keeps you guessing.

audio_system.title: How Audio Works
audio_system.desc: I used Unreal's built-in audio—MetaSounds and Sound Cues. Music came from a library. Goal was learning the engine, not building something complex.
audio_system.pause_desc: Pause the game, hear a ticking clock. That's it. No ducking, no mix changes. Keeps it simple.
audio_system.threat_desc: Music tracks are from a library. Atmospheric horror loops. No adaptive layers—just picked tracks that fit the mood.
audio_system.spatial_desc: I used UE5's HRTF plugin so footsteps and forest sounds feel like they're actually around you.

tension.title: What I Learned
tension.desc: Keep it simple. I limited mechanics to movement and one ability (pause). That let me polish the audio and visuals properly instead of spreading thin across too many features.
tension.subbass_desc: Simple, good-quality samples beat complex synthesis. Solid foley and working spatial audio carried the whole thing.
tension.silence_desc: Add real audio occlusion around walls and trees. Separate reverb for inside the cabin vs outside in the forest.
tension.misdirection_desc: Even in a basic prototype, audio makes or breaks it. The forest sounds sold the atmosphere even with rough visuals.

chase.title: AI Behavior
chase.desc: Basic nav-mesh AI. Patrols until it sees you, then chases. Gets faster every time you pause.

pause.title: Pause Mechanic
pause.desc: Pause freezes the enemy for 5 seconds. Cost: enemy gets 20% faster permanently. Max speed is 2.5x normal.

world.title: Level Design
world.desc: Linear path: Forest -> Cabin (grab key) -> Forest exit. Audio cues point you the right way.

score.title: Game Loop
score.desc: Explore, find the objective, survive the chase, escape. Checkpoints reset enemy speed so retries stay fair.

design.title: Production
design.desc: 8 weeks total. First 6 weeks: greyboxing and Blueprint logic. Last 2 weeks: audio, lighting, polish. Kept assets rough until systems worked.

tech.title: Tech Stack
tech.desc: Unreal Engine 5.1. All logic in Blueprints. Audio: MetaSounds and Sound Cues. Git for version control. Assets from libraries.
